content: Previous datasets for NL navigation based on a symbolic world representation, HCRC BIBREF5, BIBREF6, BIBREF7 and SAIL BIBREF8, BIBREF9, BIBREF10, BIBREF11, BIBREF12, BIBREF13, BIBREF14, BIBREF15 present relatively simple worlds, with a small fixed set of entities known to the navigator in advance. Such representations bypass the great complexity of real urban navigation, which consists of long paths and an abundance of previously unseen entities of different types.
